editorial: Whenever an artist pours their soul into a song, you feel the music reverberate through every part of their story. In this faith‑driven rematch, you’ll follow Bart Millard as he attempts to keep his band’s soaring hit from sounding like a confession of his own past mistakes. The intimacy of the studio sessions, where Bart lets the music bleed through his spoken words, turns each note into a confession as powerful as any sermon. You’ll appreciate how the film balances a whirlwind of tour life with gentle family moments, making it a worthy pick for anyone who loves an earnest musical biopic. A minor pacing hiccup comes midway when the tour montage stretches beyond its persuasive purpose, but the film quickly snaps back to its emotional core.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of heartfelt biographical dramas who love music and faith narratives.
similarMovies: Hank Williams: The Man & The Music
